task_request: I am a product designer, and our company is planning to build a knowledge management software product. I need you to research multiple related products, specifically Notion, Confluence, and Obsidian, and produce a visual design style research report about them. Browse their official websites, capture a screenshot of each product's key interface (1 screenshot per product). Save the screenshots with these exact filenames: notion.png, confluence.png, obsidian.png. The visual style research report should be saved as report.docx and must include: the captured screenshots, a comparative analysis table covering layout style, color palette, typography, and icon design for each product, as well as a synthesis section with design recommendations. Then, based on the analysis, synthesize the design characteristics of these products and generate three design concept images for a knowledge management software to provide design inspiration. The design concept images should be saved as fusion_design_1.png, fusion_design_2.png, and fusion_design_3.png, respectively.

nodes.objective: Browse the official Notion, Confluence, and Obsidian sites and capture one representative key-interface screenshot per product with the exact filenames notion.png, confluence.png, and obsidian.png. Record source URLs and visible design evidence.

Compare layout, color palette, typography, icon design, density, hierarchy, navigation, and interaction cues across the three products; derive explicit synthesis principles and design recommendations grounded in the captured evidence.

Generate three distinct but coherent knowledge-management interface concept images based on the synthesis, saving exactly fusion_design_1.png, fusion_design_2.png, and fusion_design_3.png. Avoid copying any single competitor and keep UI text visually plausible.

Create report.docx with all three captured screenshots, a comparative table covering the four requested dimensions, evidence-based synthesis and recommendations, and the three generated concepts with captions and interpretation.
Check all seven image files and report.docx open, filenames are exact, screenshots and concepts are embedded, and every comparison dimension is present. Report checks without changes.
